theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), let q := WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk W.toAffine; let h := q W.ψ₂; let F : ℕ → W.toAffine.CoordinateRing := fun n => q (Polynomial.C (W.preΨ' n)) * (if Even n then h else 1); ∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → F (2 * r + 1) = F (r + 2) * F r ^ 3 - F (r - 1) * F (r + 1) ^ 3
